newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Swire Prop to sell Queensway Hotel stake.
newsitem.headline: Swire Prop to sell Queensway Hotel stake.

text.p: Swire Properties Ltd said on Monday it has agreed to sell its 80 percent stake in Queensway Hotel Ltd, which owns the JW Marriott Hotel in Hong Kong, for an undisclosed figure.
The buyer is Chishore Enterprise Inc, which is 65 percent owned by Hotel Nikko Hong Kong Ltd and 35 percent by Recosia Pte Ltd.
Hotel Nikko is 95.45 percent owned by Asean Resources Holdings Ltd and CDL Hotel International Ltd.
Recosia is wholly owned by the Singapore government.

The JW Marriott Hotel Hong Kong, managed by Marriott Hong Kong Ltd, a unit of Marriott International Inc, has a gross floor area of 551,806 square feet comprising 604 guest rooms, four restaurants, a ballroom and extensive lounge areas.

"Swire Properties intends to retain its 20 percent interest in Queensway as a long-term investment in line with its 20 percent interest in each of the companies owning the Conrad International and Island Shangri-La Hotels in Pacific Place," Swire Properties managing director Keith Kerr said in a statement.
